scientific_integrity: All group/parameter cases of the claimed formulas are handled by a direct combinatorial proof. Reproducible finite tests cover selected small groups and dimensions; no independent mathematical review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to nontrivial finite groups acting on unions of fixed singletons and free regular orbits; no intermediate stabilizers or multiple commuting retractions. General priority is provisional because an older general retraction classification may specialize to this case. Finite verification does not replace proof.
title: Unit-conjugacy classification of equivariant retractions with fixed and free orbits
